tasks.label: Verify capstone project markdown
args: const Database=require('better-sqlite3'); const db=new Database('dev.db',{readonly:true}); const rows=db.prepare("SELECT slug,title,content FROM Lesson WHERE type='project' AND title LIKE '%CAPSTONE%' LIMIT 5").all(); console.log(rows.map(r=>({slug:r.slug,title:r.title}))); const headings=['## 📌 Overview','## ✅ Prerequisites','## 🧰 Suggested Stack','## 🧭 Milestones','## ✅ Acceptance Criteria','## 🧪 Starter Commands','## 🧯 Incident Runbooks','## 🌟 Stretch Goals','## Deliverables']; for(const r of rows){ console.log('\n'+r.slug+' -> '+r.title); for(const h of headings){ console.log(' ', (r.content||'').includes(h)?'OK ':'NO ', h); }}
